posts.t:
Al3cs wrote: During those DDs, how do you cover your position? Hedging? No SL?

MPL should be around above source of drop.. but in real trade I never suggest hold huge DD unless you understand your MM and R/R

in real trade I should be out somewhere around mid range...thenmaybe look for another opportunity.... depend on our trading style, in this mid range trade you can try put SL nearby mid range zone (SL should be around 2-5 pips for example) but often get hitted by SL (personal experience) if trading without SL.....(pls avoid during important news) if our mid range zone was consumed at least we can expect price PB then get out immediately or price just keep going(clean DBD or RBR) then cut loss for sure

posts.t:
18:00 GMT USD FOMC Minutes REPORT Get more information about: FOMC Minutes United States FOMC stands for The Federal Open Market Committee that organizes 8 meetings in a year and reviews economic and financial conditions, determines the appropriate stance of monetary policy and assesses the risks to its long-run goals of price stability and sustainable economic growth. FOMC Minutes are released by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve and are a clear guide to the future US interest rate policy.

As the report is not instant, there is need for trader to process and take new position or stay in the old ones.
posts.fa:
18:00 GMT گزارش FOMC Minutes آمریکا، اطلاعات بیشتر دربارهٔ: FOMC Minutes ایالات متحده، FOMC مخفف کمیتهٔ بازار باز فدرال است که 8 جلسه در سال برگزار می‌کند و شرایط اقتصادی و مالی را بازبینی می‌کند، موضع مناسب سیاست پولی را تعیین می‌کند و ریسک‌ها را برای اهداف بلندمدت ثبات قیمت و رشد اقتصادی پایدار ارزیابی می‌کند. FOMC Minutes توسط هیئت مدیرهٔ فدرال رزرو منتشر می‌شود و راهنمای روشنی برای سیاست نرخ بهرهٔ آیندهٔ آمریکاست.

چون گزارش فوری نیست، معامله‌گر باید فرصت داشته باشد پردازش کند و پوزیشن جدید بگیرد یا در قدیمی‌ها بماند.
